caption: The drawing features a detailed rendering of an object resembling a manual kitchen whisk or egg beater lying diagonally across the page from bottom left to upper right. The handle is brown, likely made of wood, and tapers slightly at the end with a wider grip section at the top. The handle is joined to a shiny, metallic twisted shaft, which extends into a spherical cage made of metal strips at the bottom. Inside this cage, there is a central horizontal disk that appears to have cutouts or writing on it. Above and to the left of the main object, there is a black-ink line drawing of the central disk, showing it from a top-down perspective as a cross shape. To the lower right of the handle, a similar black-ink line drawing depicts a side view of the whisk’s metal cage, showing the arrangement and curvature of the strips. The background is a plain off-white or cream color, and the artist’s signature is present in the lower left corner.
title: Egg Beater
